description: Source code for decoding protocol buffer data, including functions for reading varints, fixed-length integers, zigzag-encoded integers, raw bytes, and message unmarshaling, primarily for internal use within the protobuf decoding process.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A struct representing a buffer for decoding protocol buffer data, with methods for decoding various wire types and managing internal state.

methods.name: DecodeVarint
methods.description: Reads a varint-encoded integer from a byte slice.

methods.name: decodeVarintSlow
methods.description: Decodes a varint from the buffer when fast path is not applicable.

methods.name: DecodeVarint
methods.description: Reads a varint-encoded integer from the Buffer object.

methods.name: DecodeFixed64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit fixed-length integer from the Buffer.

methods.name: DecodeFixed32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit fixed-length integer from the Buffer.

methods.name: DecodeZigzag64
methods.description: Decodes a zigzag-encoded 64-bit integer from the Buffer.

methods.name: DecodeZigzag32
methods.description: Decodes a zigzag-encoded 32-bit integer from the Buffer.

methods.name: DecodeRawBytes
methods.description: Reads a length-delimited byte slice from the Buffer.

methods.name: DecodeStringBytes
methods.description: Reads an encoded string from the Buffer.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Parses a protocol buffer message from a byte slice into a Message object.

methods.name: UnmarshalMerge
methods.description: Parses and merges a protocol buffer message from a byte slice into a Message object.

methods.name: DecodeMessage
methods.description: Reads a length-delimited message from the Buffer into a Message.

methods.name: DecodeGroup
methods.description: Reads a group message from the Buffer into a Message, consuming the end group tag.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Decodes the protocol buffer data in the Buffer into a Message, without resetting the message beforehand.
